sentences.text: Cooper, a 6-year-old neutered Labrador Retriever, is on day 46 of 56 of an owner-entered Royal Canin HP trial, and chicken appears on 29 of 154 meals and treats, including Dentastix daily from Jun 8 on the owner-entered allowed list and at least 4 off-list feedings, the last Jun 27.

Itching was logged on 16 of 43 logged days, over at least 35 days, and this is not a test of the diet: Apoquel 16 mg once daily, doses not logged, NexGard from Jun 5, flavour protein unknown, and Dentastix from Jun 8 all overlap the trial.
On Jun 18 the owner wrote “flare after the chicken on Sunday”, Sunday being Jun 14; this was not tested, and chicken was fed daily from Jun 8.
Itch severity and body site are unknown.
